facts.condition: Conditional on the binary-alphabet Marton reduction, any blocklength-two construction that strictly outperforms the established product time-sharing construction must induce a distribution on the four joint inputs with support cardinality greater than two.

assumptions: The binary-input Marton reduction invoked by the accepted claim applies to every induced subchannel with at most two active joint-input symbols.
The comparison uses the channel, two-use normalization, and product time-sharing benchmark fixed by the governed BSSC problem.
